pro_course_detail.title: Step 1: Accent Assessment
pro_course_detail.description:
It is important to note that the Accent Reduction Assessment is a valuable tool used to measure an individual's pronunciation and intonation relative to the Standard American Accent. Upon completion of the assessment, the client will receive a report outlining any existing problems and the severity of each issue for the 44 English-American sounds/phonemes and evaluation of their intonation. The final score will indicate the percentage of correctly pronounced American English sounds/phonemes, with a perfect score being 100, representing the Standard American Accent. It is important to strive for a score as close to 100 as possible, as this indicates a higher level of accuracy in pronunciation and intonation.

The assessment consists of a comprehensive range of English sounds (phonemes). The candidate will read the assessment and provide a speech sample that will be recorded. Afterward, the candidate's performance will be scored, and the results will be shared with the client within five business days.

pro_course_detail.description:

Do you like homework?  Me too!  Your time is valuable, and homework helps you get the most out of class time. I enjoy sending a short article or video before each class.  You can choose a topic that you are interested in, or I can choose the topic. Then I will bring some interesting discussion questions to class so we will always have something unique to talk about. This is a relaxed type of class. Mistakes are a part of the learning process and allow us to grow. 
I encourage you to take risks, make mistakes, and enjoy the process. Throughout the class, I will take notes on a shared Google Doc with suggestions to help you sound more like a native speaker, as well as new words and phrases.  This way, you can review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:

First we will learn new vocabulary words, practice seeing them in context, then practice using them out loud.  We will also cover all the grammar points necessary in order to master the English language.

Since these are private lessons, they are 100% customized to your needs.  Not sure when to use the past perfect? Then we can start with the past perfect.  Or would you rather focus on vocabulary related to business?  You're the boss.  During your first lesson, we will create a learning plan to help you accomplish your goals. But if you're not sure where to start, I can do a short assessment of your current level, and help you decide where to begin.  

This course typically involves reading, writing, speaking, and listening exercises. In order to get the most out of your class time, most of the reading, writing, and listening exercises are given as homework.  This way, we can spend more time speaking during class.  And of course, we will focus more on the skills that are most relevant to your goals.
